nom: COSRX 5 PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Vital Hydrating Hydrogel Mask with Collagen & Adenosine

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask leaves their face moisturized and brighter, with one calling it a winter life saver for dryness.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin found the mask lightweight and non-irritating, while another notes hyaluronic acid can feel sensitizing when combined with retinol.

concerns.aging: One reviewer using the mask overnight reports visible improvement to lines and skin texture.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the mask as strongly hydrating, leaving skin plump, soft, and non-dry the next morning, with no dry or itchy patches reported.
concerns.redness: A single reviewer notes hyaluronic acid combined with retinol left skin feeling sensitive, though this is not described by others.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the mask worked well without irritation, but no other acne-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewers specifically discuss blemish reduction beyond the one acne-prone reviewer's positive tolerance experience.

aspects.libelle: Long wear time required (2+ hours or overnight)
Mask slides down or slips off face
Packaging can arrive wrinkled, affecting fit
Feels like a spa-quality luxury treatment

extraits.texte: So this is my first time using a mask overnight and at first I was worried about what I would wake up to, but this was actually super comfortable. Cooling, hydrating and not sticky. There was not a dry or itchy patch in sight when I took it off in the morning. There was also none of that serum dripping into the corners of my eyes and burning business. My skin looked visibly brighter and plumper. Like I'm out here feeling like the definition of Sunny QQ. I would 100 percent recommend this to others and will be buying it for my Sunday self care refresh evening routine.

These masks are lightweight yet so moisturizing! It doesn't feel sticky or thick in a bad way. It really nourishes the skin, especially after shaving. It is really great for my sensitive acne prone skin. I love the rubber type mask because it really holds the moisture in and doesn't evaporate like other masks!

These have really been helping my dry skin this winter. My face feels much more moisturized and looks brighter after one mask! I will definitely be getting more so that I can keep it up during the dry months.

extraits.titre: See instant results in your skin
extraits.texte: The best mask I have ever used Works best overnight which is a bit inconvenient and uncomfortable but in the morning there is visual improvement to lines and skin texture I love this product!
You can see hydration on my face! My skin glowing after overnight mask. . I only noticed that hyaluronic acid is not very good for skin if you use retinol and it might feel sensitive.

I like this mask a lot! It feels very soothing on the skin, and is comfortable to wear. After it dried a little I was able to blow dry my hair with it on! The only thing is I think the packaging could be improved because when I took it out of the package, the bottom part of the top half was wrinkled as it had slid out of the plastic packaging inside the pack. This interferes somewhat with the ability of the mask to stick to your nose, since that's already a difficult area for masks to stick to due to the curvature. Otherwise, I love it and can't wait to use the rest of the masks!

extraits.titre: Too early to notice any results
extraits.texte: I used this mask, but I wasn't sure what the outcome was supposed to be. It left my skin moisturized and bright, but I'm not entirely sure how that's different from other masks. Maybe more uses will bring about results
